# hiok_vpn_gateway (Resource)

A VPN gateway. Point-to-Site issues OpenVPN client profiles; Site-to-Site builds WireGuard tunnels to remote networks.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `address_pool` (String) Range handed to connecting clients, for example 10.71.0.0/24.
- `dns_servers` (List of String)
- `gateway_type` (Number) 0 for Site-to-Site (WireGuard), 1 for Point-to-Site (OpenVPN).
- `port` (Number)
- `protocol` (String) "openvpn" or "wireguard".
- `region` (String)
- `split_tunneling` (Boolean)
- `subnet_cidr` (String)
- `subnet_id` (String)
- `vnet_id` (String)
- `vnet_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `public_ip_address` (String) Address clients dial.
- `status` (String)
- `vpn_configuration` (String, Sensitive) A ready-to-use client profile generated with the gateway. It embeds private key material, so it is marked sensitive.
